title: Need assistance creating a simple Final Fantasy-like summoning system

posts.author: SuperPhillip
posts.body:
Hi, all. Currently returning to active RPG Maker MV game development, and I wanted to make a summoning system as seen in the earlier Final Fantasy games (IV and VI, for instance) where a summon appears on screen, does its magical effect/animation, then disappears. I know that part can be done as simply as utilizing animations and combining them with spells/skills/magic/etc.
The part I'm tripped up on is having any character be able to equip a summon and unequip it at any time outside of battle. My magic system is currently one where players use "items" to learn spells. I don't want Summons to work like this because there aren't more than one item for the same Summon. You can't exactly go to an in-game shop and buy a mystical Summon like you could basic "Fire" magic, understandably.
Thus, what I'd like is the ability for a given party member to be able to equip a summon, use it with MP (in battles only), and be able to unequip it when they're outside of battle, as wanted and needed.
Would this be done with an Accessory, and if so, can I have a second equipment slot (pretty much a second Accessory slot) dedicated exclusively for Summons? If so, how would I implement that?
Thanks for reading, and if you need further elaboration on anything, please let me know and I'll do my best to do so.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:

You just add it to the Types tab in your database.

posts.author: SuperPhillip
posts.body:
Haha. That simple, huh! Thank you! That's always the issue I have with returning to RPG Maker (or anything quite in-depth) after a long time away--I forget how to do some of the most basic things and use some of the simplest features.
I appreciate your help!
